blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. They leverage the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels as a common geometric reference across model updates. Since this reference depends on the number of classes, adding new ones expands the simplex, misaligning existing class prototypes with their earlier counterparts. We therefore derive a deterministic linear transformation to restore their alignment. Our theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility definition identifies two geometric conditions under which its inequalities hold in expectation, assuming von Mises--Fisher class distributions with increasing concentration across updates. Aligned regular-simplex representations satisfy these conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the proposed representations under the stated assumptions. Without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or architectural modifications, the proposed representations achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, including expanded class sets, more expressive architectures, and independently trained models from public repositories.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, limiting accessibility to a few well-resourced organizations ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Dubey et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Anthropic, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) . Despite reductions in model parameters and computing costs ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) , training from scratch, fine-tuning, and inference remain economically challenging ( Wang et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) .
As a result, models are increasingly released through public repositories ( Marcel & Rodriguez, 2010 ; Wolf et al., 2019 ; Wightman, 2019 ) or provided as services through APIs, simplifying application development and enabling widespread adoption across domains.
blocks.zh:
现代AI模式的培训越来越昂贵,限制了少数资源丰富的组织的无障碍性(Radford等人,2021年;Dubey等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2023年;Anthropic,2024年;Yang等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年;Team等人,2026年). 尽管模型参数和计算成本减少(Dubey等人,2024年),但从零开始的培训、微调和推论在经济上仍然具有挑战性(Wang等人,2025年;OpenAI,2024年)。
因此,模型越来越多地通过公共寄存器发布(Marcel & Rodriguez,2010年;Wolf等人,2019年;Wightman,2019年),或者通过API作为服务提供,简化了应用开发,并使得跨领域广泛采用.

blocks.en:
As these models become more integrated into real-world systems, the need to update them is also growing. This demand is driven by several factors ( Raffel, 2023 ; Yadav et al., 2025 ) , including evolving training strategies ( Biondi et al., 2026 ; Biondi et al., 2024 ; Echterhoff et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2020 ) , advancements in model architectures ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Kaplan et al., 2020 ) , the availability of higher-quality datasets ( Gunasekar et al., 2023 ) , the expansion of training classes, or extended training periods ( Biderman et al., 2023 ; Raffel, 2023 ) .
Such updates not only improve performance but also bring the rapid progress of the field into deployed models, simplifying their adoption despite the continued growth in the scale and complexity of models, datasets, and infrastructures ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Sorscher et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
随着这些模型日益融入现实世界的系统,更新这些模型的必要性也在增加。 这一需求是由几个因素驱动的(Raffel, 2023年;Yadav等人, 2025年),包括不断发展的培训战略(Biondi等人, 2026年;Biondi等人, 2024年;Echterhoff等人, 2024年;Shen等人, 2020年),模型建筑的进步(Touvron等人, 2023年;Kaplan等人, 2020年), 提供高质量的数据集(Gunasekar等人, 2023年), 扩大培训课程,或延长培训期(Biderman等人, 2023年;Raffel, 2023年)。
尽管模型、数据集和基础设施的规模和复杂性持续增加,但这种更新不仅改善了业绩,而且使外地的快速进展成为已部署模型,简化了这些模型的采用(Bommasani等人,2021年;Sorscher等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
However, a significant drawback of model updates is that they can compromise compatibility with earlier versions, altering the behavior of applications or services built upon them ( Raffel, 2023 ) .
For example, image retrieval services might experience unexpected changes in image rankings following a model update, forcing users to adapt when previously top-ranked images no longer appear first ( Shen et al., 2020 ) .
Similarly, end users, such as drivers of semi-autonomous cars, often develop a mental model of the machine learning system’s capabilities ( Bansal et al., 2019a ) .
When updates modify system behavior, users must adjust their mental model of the system’s functionality, a task that can be challenging, dissatisfying, and even unsafe ( Bansal et al., 2019b ; Templeton, 2019 ) .
Recent observations have highlighted similar issues with large language models (LLMs) ( Echterhoff et al., 2024 ; Goswami et al., 2026 ) , raising concerns about AI safety and alignment. This is particularly critical when decisions and textual outputs from these agents are translated into actions ( Amodei et al., 2016 ; Ngo et al., 2024 ) .
In such settings, it is essential that the predictions of the updated model mimic those of the old model for any correct classification ( Milani Fard et al., 2016 ; Yan et al., 2021 ; Ricci et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,模型更新的一个显著缺点是,它们可以损害与早期版本的兼容性,改变基于它们的应用程序或服务的行为(Raffel, 2023).
例如,图像检索服务可能会在模型更新后出现意想不到的图像排名变化,迫使用户在先前排名最高的图像不再先出现时进行调整(Shen等人,2020年).
同样,终端用户,如半自主汽车的驾驶员,经常开发机器学习系统能力的精神模型(Bansal等人,2019a). 。 。 。
当更新系统行为时,用户必须调整其系统功能的心理模型,这项任务可能具有挑战性,令人不满意,甚至不安全(Bansal等人,2019b;Templeton,2019).
近期的观察突出了与大语言模型(LLMs)的类似问题(Echterhoff等人,2024年;Goswami等人,2026年),引起对AI安全性和一致性的关注. 当这些代理人的决定和文字产出转化为行动时,这一点尤为重要(Amodei等人,2016年;Ngo等人,2024年)。
在这种情况下,更新模型的预测必须模仿旧模型的预测,以便进行正确的分类(Milani Fard等人,2016年); Yan等人,2021年;Ricci等人,2026年b).

blocks.en:
Updating a model while ensuring compatibility with its earlier versions has been explored along three complementary dimensions:
1) Weights-level, which explores the merging of model parameters under the assumption of linear mode connectivity, to unify multiple versions into a single, robust model ( Frankle et al., 2020 ; Wortsman et al., 2022 ; Ainsworth et al., 2023 ) ; 2) Representation-level, which seeks to learn backward-compatible representations that are comparable across model updates, so they can be used interchangeably over time ( Shen et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2021 ; Biondi et al., 2026 ) ; and 3) Classifier decision-level, which ensures that the updated model preserves the correct predictions of the old model, preventing negative flips ( Milani Fard et al., 2016 ; Yan et al., 2021 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
They target distinct notions of compatibility and accordingly differ in their objectives, mechanisms, and evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh:
围绕以下三个相辅相成的方面,探讨了更新一个模型,同时确保与以前的版本兼容:
1)Weights-level,探索在线性模式互联互通的假设下将模型参数合并,将多个版本统一为一个单一,强健的模型(Frankle等人,2020年;Wortsman等人,2022年;Ainsworth等人,2023年);2) 代表层,寻求学习跨模型更新的可比较的后向兼容表达,以便随着时间的推移可以互换使用(Shen等人,2020年;Meng等人,2021年;Biondi等人,2026年);3) 分类式决策层,确保更新模型保持旧模型的正确预测,防止负翻转(Milani Fard等人,2016年); Yan et al., 2021; Zhao et al., 2024 ).
它们针对的是不同的兼容性概念,因此其目标、机制和评价标准各不相同。

blocks.en:
Among these paradigms, we focus on representation-level compatibility, which is particularly relevant to retrieval systems, where feature representations produced by different model versions must remain directly comparable.
Backward-compatibility training, introduced by Shen et al. (2020) to avoid image re-indexing of the gallery set, has been established as a standard training paradigm to achieve backward-compatibility between model representations.
However, most existing studies on backward-compatibility require training a new model using the old model as a reference ( Shen et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2021 ; Duggal et al., 2021 ; Pan et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ) .
This approach has become increasingly challenging due to restricted access to old model architectures and weights—often limited by proprietary constraints and non-disclosure policies—as well as the high computational costs associated with training large-scale modern AI models.
Recent studies ( Biondi et al., 2023a ; Biondi et al., 2024 ; Biondi et al., 2026 ) have addressed this limitation by learning compatible representations without explicitly using the previous model as a reference. However, these approaches require all parties to agree in advance on a shared, pre-allocated fixed classifier ( Pernici et al., 2019 ; Pernici et al., 2021a ; Zhu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
在这些范式中,我们侧重于代表级别的兼容性,这与检索系统特别相关,不同模型版本制作的特征表示必须保持直接可比性.
后向兼容培训由沈等人(2020年)推出,以避免画廊套装的图像重新索引,现已确立为标准培训模式,实现模型表达的后向兼容.
然而,大多数关于落后兼容性的现有研究都需要以旧模型作为参考来培训新的模型(沈等人,2020年;孟等人,2021年;杜格尔等人,2021年;潘等人,2023年;周等人,2023年).
这种方法越来越具有挑战性,因为对旧的模型结构和权重的获取受到限制——往往受到专利限制和不披露政策的限制——以及培训大规模现代人工智能模型的高昂计算成本。
最近的研究(Biondi等人,2023a;Biondi等人,2024;Biondi等人,2026)通过学习兼容的表示法解决了这一限制,但没有明确地将以前的模型作为参考. 然而,这些办法要求所有缔约方事先商定一个共享的、预先分配的固定分类器(Pernici等人,2019年;Pernici等人,2021年a); 朱等, 2021 ).

blocks.en:
In this paper, we show that hyperspherical simplex representations derived from the softmax outputs or logits of independently trained 1 1 1 In this work, the term independently trained means that no model is trained using an earlier model’s parameters, representations, outputs, or compatibility losses. Models may nevertheless share the task, data, initialization, and label-to-output coordinate convention. models provide backward-compatible retrieval.
Our formulation leverages the simplex geometry induced during training by the softmax function and one-hot encoded class labels as a model-agnostic reference,
yielding hyperspherical simplex representations that are aligned across model updates.
Since their simplex geometries evolve with the introduction of new classes, we propose a deterministic linear transformation that compensates for the resulting angular misalignment between the prototypes of existing classes and their earlier counterparts, thereby preserving their alignment.
We theoretically analyze the formal backward-compatibility definition and identify geometric conditions under which its inequalities ( Shen et al., 2020 ) hold in expectation, given explicit assumptions on the feature distributions and their concentration across updates.
We then show that these conditions are satisfied by aligned regular-simplex representations, and therefore by the proposed hyperspherical simplex representations, which exhibit this geometry.
Although the proposed hyperspherical simplex representations satisfy the geometric conditions established in our analysis, their dimensionality increases linearly with the number of training classes, resulting in substantial storage costs for large-scale galleries.
To mitigate this limitation, we adopt a top- k k sparsification strategy motivated by the rank-preserving property of the softmax function and the top- k k calibration of the softmax cross-entropy loss ( Lapin et al., 2016 ; Yang & Koyejo, 2020 ) , which reduces gallery storage with negligible changes in retrieval accuracy and without degrading compatibility.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are the following: 1. We introduce a novel approach for backward-compatible retrieval based on hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits. 2. We provide a theoretical analysis of the formal definition of backward-compatibility, identifying geometric conditions under which its inequalities are satisfied in expectation, given explicit distributional and concentration assumptions. We show that hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits satisfy these geometric conditions. 3. We propose a top- k k sparsification method for hyperspherical simplex representations, motivated by the rank-preserving property of the softmax function and the top- k k calibration of the softmax cross-entropy loss, to reduce representation storage. 4. We achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, obtaining substantial improvements in scenarios involving a large number of model updates, without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or modifications to the model architecture.
We provide empirical evidence that representations derived from softmax outputs and logits substantially improve backward-compatibility, even between independently pretrained models obtained from a public repository.

blocks.en:
The remainder of the paper is organized as follows.
In Sec. 2 , we review related work on backward-compatibility.
In Sec. 3 , we derive hyperspherical simplex representations from softmax outputs and logits and analyze their backward-compatibility under stated theoretical assumptions.
In Sec. 4 , we present extensive experiments and compare our proposed method with state-of-the-art alternatives.
Finally, in Sec. 5 , we draw conclusions and discuss the limitations of this work.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Backward-compatibility was first formalized by Shen et al. (2020) , who defined both theoretical and empirical criteria to verify whether learned representations are interoperable across model updates, thus eliminating the need to re-index the gallery set in retrieval systems.
To learn backward-compatible representations, they proposed Backward-Compatible Training (BCT), where the previously learned classifier is frozen and serves as a fixed reference during training of the new model, aligning new feature vectors with their corresponding old class prototypes.
Subsequent work proposed additional regularization objectives to enforce alignment between old and new representations ( Budnik & Avrithis, 2021 ; Duggal et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; Pan et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2022 ; Goswami et al., 2026 ) .
In Meng et al. (2021) , a combination of loss functions is used to align class means between different model updates and to achieve more compact intra-class distributions while learning new information, directly optimizing a point-to-set formulation of backward-compatibility.
In Zhang et al. (2021) , compatible representations are learned with a contrastive loss that encourages each new-to-old positive pair to be more similar than both new-to-old and new-to-new negative pairs. Pan et al. (2023) introduce an adversarial discriminator within BCT to minimize the distribution gap between features from the old and new models.
In these regularization-based approaches, due to the constraints imposed to achieve compatibility, the performance of the new backward-compatible model often does not reach that of a newly independently trained model ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , trained without using the old model as a reference.
To address this issue, Zhou et al. (2023) and Ricci et al. (2024) focus on modifying the model architecture by expanding the feature space at each model update, such that the original subspace preserves compatibility with previous models, while information from the new data is learned in the additional dimensions. However, even if compatibility is achieved while retaining the discriminative performance of a newly independently trained model, these approaches require explicit modifications to the model architecture that introduce growing complexity with each successive feature space expansion.

在Meng et al. (2021)中,损失函数的组合用于将不同模型更新之间的类符对齐,并在学习新信息的同时实现更紧凑的类内分布,直接优化了后向兼容的点对点的配方.
在张等人(2021年)中,相容的表示法以对比性损失来学习,鼓励每对新老正配对比新老正配对更相似. 潘等编著. (2023)在BCT内部引入对抗性歧视者,以最大限度地缩小新旧模式特征之间的分配差距.
在这些基于规范化的方法中,由于实现兼容性所施加的限制,新的后向兼容模型的性能往往没有达到新独立训练的模型(周等人,2023年),训练时没有使用旧模型作为参考.
为解决这一问题,周 al等人(2023年)和瑞奇等人. (2024)注重通过在每一个模型更新时扩展特征空间来修改模型架构,这样原来的子空间就保留了与之前模型的兼容性,而从新数据中获取的信息则是在额外的维度中学习的. 然而,即使实现了兼容性同时又保留了新独立训练的模型的歧视性性能,这些方法也需要对模型结构进行明确的修改,这种结构随着每个连续的特征空间扩展而带来越来越大的复杂性.

blocks.en:
Along a different line, several studies have proposed mapping-based approaches to achieve compatibility across model updates ( Chen et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2021 ; Ramanujan et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Jaeckle et al., 2023 ; Ricci et al., 2025 ) .
These methods learn mapping functions to align corresponding representations of the same inputs obtained from two different models, enabling direct comparison between them.
Such approaches are closely related to prior work in cross-model and cross-modal representation learning, where alignment between feature spaces of different models or modalities is a central objective ( Moschella et al., 2023 ; Cannistraci et al., 2023 ; Cannistraci et al., 2024 ; Maniparambil et al., 2024 ; Maniparambil et al., 2025 ; Ricci et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
沿着不同的思路,一些研究提出了实现模型更新兼容性的基于绘图的方法(Chen等人,2019年;Wang等人,2020年;Meng等人,2021年;Ramanujan等人,2022年;Hu等人,2022年;Jaeckle等人,2023年;Ricci等人,2025年)。
这些方法学习绘图功能,使从两个不同模型获得的相同投入的相应表述一致,从而能够直接比较。
这种做法与以往在跨模式和跨模式代表学习方面的工作密切相关,在不同模式或模式的特征空间之间保持一致是一个中心目标(Moschella等人,2023年;Cannistraci等人,2023年;Cannistraci等人,2024年;Maniprambil等人,2024年;Maniprambil等人,2025年;Ricci等人,2026年a年)。

blocks.en:
However, feature-space alignment alone does not guarantee satisfaction of the formal compatibility inequalities, and mapping-based approaches introduce significant overhead in scenarios with many model updates, as they require composing multiple learned mapping functions across successive updates.
To address these limitations, the solution proposed by Biondi et al. (2023a) ; Biondi et al. (2023b) ; Biondi et al. (2024) ; Biondi et al. (2026) involves learning with a pre-allocated d d -simplex fixed classifier, which enforces feature alignment across updates by fixing the position of class prototypes a priori (i.e., from the beginning of training), while accommodating new classes within pre-allocated regions of the feature space.
Although this approach achieves compatibility without using the old model as a reference, it relies on the same pre-allocated fixed classifier across model updates and requires architectural modifications.
blocks.zh:
然而,仅靠地物空间协调并不能保证满足形式上的兼容性不平等,而基于制图的方法在附有许多模型更新的情景中引入了重大的间接费用,因为它们需要在整个连续更新过程中组合多种学到的绘图功能。
为解决这些限制,Biondi等人(2023a),Biondi等人(2023b),Biondi等人(2024),Biondi等人(2026)提出的解决方案涉及使用预先分配的d-simpex固定分类器进行学习,通过先验确定班级原型(即从培训开始)的位置,同时在预分配的地段空间内容纳新的班级,从而在更新时实施特征一致。
虽然这种方法在不使用旧模型作为参考的情况下实现了兼容性,但它依赖于相同的预先分配的固定分类器跨模型更新,需要建筑改造.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we show that hyperspherical representations with an aligned regular-simplex geometry can be obtained directly from the logits or softmax outputs of independently trained models, without requiring a pre-allocated fixed classifier shared across updates. Building on this observation, we derive hyperspherical simplex representations for backward-compatible retrieval that do not require additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mapping functions, or modifications to the model architecture.
At the theoretical level, while Biondi et al. (2026) numerically show that stationary d d -simplex representations satisfy the compatibility inequalities in expectation, our analysis complements this result by providing closed-form geometric conditions for aligned hyperspherical representations under explicit distributional model assumptions.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们显示,具有对齐的正态-平面几何的超球面表示可以直接从独立训练的模型的对数输出或软度输出中获取,而不需要预先分配的固定分类器在更新中共享. 基于这一观察,我们得出了超球形的简单表达式,用于后向兼容检索,不需要额外的兼容性特定损失,学习的映射功能,或修改模型架构.
在理论层面上,而比翁迪等人. (2026)数字显示,Statent d-simplex 表示满足了预期中的兼容性不平等,我们的分析通过在明确的分布模型假设下为对齐的超球形表示提供闭合的几何条件来补充这一结果.

blocks.en: 3 Compatibility of Hyperspherical Simplex Representations
blocks.zh: 3 超球形简单表示的兼容性

blocks.en: In this section, we first introduce hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits. We then identify geometric conditions under which the compatibility inequalities of Shen et al. (2020) hold in expectation given explicit assumptions on the feature distributions and their increasing concentration across model updates. Finally, we show that the proposed representations satisfy these conditions.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先引入从软磁输出和对数中衍生出来的超球形简单x表示. 然后,我们确定沈等人(2020年)的兼容性不平等的几何条件,考虑到对特征分布的明确假设及其在模型更新中的日益集中,我们期待这些条件。 最后,我们表明,所提议的陈述符合这些条件。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries and Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 先决条件和动机

In retrieval tasks, the inequalities in Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b suggest that the updated model representation, when used to compare against the old representation, should perform at least as well as the old one in grouping images from the same classes and separating those from different classes.
While Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b describe desirable goals for compatible representations, directly verifying them requires exhaustive pairwise comparisons between the two representations, which is impractical at scale ( Shen et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
在检索任务中,Eq. 1a和Eq. 1b中的不平等表明,更新的模型表述方式,在用于比较旧的表述方式时,至少应该与旧的模型一样,将图像分组到同一类,并将不同类的图像分开。
虽然Eq. 1a和Eq. 1b描述了兼容表述的可取目标,但直接核实这两个表述需要彻底的对等比较,这在规模上是不切实际的(Shen等人,2020年)。

blocks.en:
To obtain a numerical assessment of these inequalities, Biondi et al. (2024) ; Biondi et al. (2026) estimate the corresponding expected distances through Monte Carlo integration under the unconstrained feature model (UFM) assumption ( Mixon et al., 2022 ) , considering feature distributions centered around the prototypes of a pre-allocated d d -simplex fixed classifier.
In their initial analysis, Biondi et al. (2024) model class features as samples from Euclidean hyperballs and evaluate compatibility using Euclidean distance. Under this formulation, the different-class inequality (Eq. 1b ) is not satisfied, and stationary d d -simplex representations are therefore characterized as an optimal approximation to backward-compatibility. Extending this analysis, Biondi et al. (2026) model class features as samples from hyperspherical caps on the unit hypersphere and evaluate compatibility using cosine distance. Assuming that the hyperspherical caps shrink across model updates, they demonstrate that both compatibility inequalities hold in expectation for representations learned with a pre-allocated d d -simplex fixed classifier.
blocks.zh:
为了对这些不平等进行数字评估,Biondi等人(2024年);Biondi等人(2026年)根据不受限制的特征模型假设(Mixon等人,2022年),估计了通过蒙特卡洛整合的相应预期距离,同时考虑到以预先分配d-simpex固定分类器原型为中心的特征分布。
在最初的分析中,Biondi等人(2024年)的模型类特征作为来自欧几利得超球的样本,并利用欧几利得距离来评价兼容性. 根据这一提法,不同阶级的不平等(Eq. 1b.)没有得到满足,因此,固定的d-simpex表述被定性为与落后兼容性的最佳近似。 扩展这一分析,Biondi等人(2026年)的模型类特征作为单位超球盖上的样本,并使用余弦距离评价兼容性. 假设超球盖跨模型更新缩小,它们表明两种兼容性不平等都存在于预分配的d-simplex固定分类器所学到的表示值上。

blocks.en:
While these studies assess compatibility numerically for stationary d d -simplex representations, we analytically characterize the compatibility inequalities and identify geometric conditions under which they are satisfied in expectation.
Specifically, we model hyperspherical features using von Mises–Fisher (vMF) distributions on the unit hypersphere ( Fisher, 1953 ; Banerjee et al., 2005 ) , which yield closed-form expressions for the expected cosine distances in terms of class prototype directions and concentration parameters.
Assuming that the concentration of the class distributions increases across model updates, we prove in Theorem 3.6 of Sec. 3.4 that both inequalities of Def. 3.1 are satisfied in expectation if the following two geometric conditions hold: (a) corresponding class prototypes are aligned across updates; (b) the angle between prototypes of different classes is greater than π / 2 \pi/2 .
blocks.zh:
虽然这些研究对d-simplex平稳表示的兼容性进行了数字评估,但我们从分析角度对兼容性不平等作了定性,并确定了期望它们满足的几何条件。
具体来说,我们使用 von Mises – Fisher (vMF) 分布在单位超平面上模拟超球面特征(Fisher, 1953; Banerjee et al., 2005),在类原型方向和浓度参数方面产生预期的余弦距离的封闭式表达.
假设阶级分布的集中度在模型更新中增加,我们在3.4se的定理3.6中证明了Def的不平等. 3.1 如果以下两个几何条件存在,则在预期中满足:(a) 相应的类原型在更新之间对齐;(b) 不同类原型之间的角度大于 / 2\pi/2 。

blocks.en: corresponding class prototypes are aligned across updates;
blocks.zh: 相应的类原型在各种更新中保持一致;

blocks.en: the angle between prototypes of different classes is greater than π / 2 \pi/2 .
blocks.zh: 不同类的原型之间的角度大于 π / 2\ pi/2 。

blocks.en:
In particular, both conditions are satisfied by regular-simplex representations that are centered at the origin and aligned across model updates, as established in Cor. 3.7 .
Since softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels induces a simplex structure in both the softmax outputs and the logits, these provide a principled basis for constructing backward-compatible representations without compatibility-specific training.
Accordingly, the two conditions directly guide the design of the proposed representations: condition (b) motivates the centering projection introduced in Sec. 3.2.1 , whereas condition (a) motivates the angular correction under class expansion described in Sec. 3.3 .

特别是,这两种条件都通过以原样为中心并按Cor.3.7所述对各模型进行更新的普通-简单表述方式得到满足。
由于带有单热标签的软马克思交叉式训练在软马克思输出和对数中都诱导出一个简单的x结构,因此这些训练为在不进行兼容性特定训练的情况下构建落后兼容的表示提供了原则基础.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Features Derived From Logits
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 源自逻辑的特征

blocks.en:
The simplex geometry induced by softmax cross-entropy training is reflected not only in the softmax outputs but also in the underlying logits.
Motivated by the UFM analyses of Mixon et al. (2022) and Fang et al. (2021) , we analyze this relationship directly at the level of the logits.
Specifically, rather than modeling the shared backbone and classifier, we treat the logit vector of each training sample as an independent optimization variable, initialized at the origin (i.e., at the equiprobable softmax distribution), and study its evolution under gradient descent on the softmax cross-entropy loss; we refer to this abstraction as the logit-UFM.
This formulation isolates the geometry induced directly by the loss from the additional interactions introduced by the network architecture and shared model parameters, leading to the following proposition:
blocks.zh:
软max跨内线训练诱导的简单x几何不仅体现在软max输出中,也体现在基础对数中.
根据Mixon等人(2022年)和Fang等人(2021年)的UFM分析,我们直接在对数一级分析这种关系。
具体来说,我们不模拟共享主干线和分类器,而是将每个训练样本的对数矢量作为一个独立优化变量,初始化于原产地(即可装备软马克斯分布地),并研究其在软马克斯交叉热带损失上梯度下降下的演变;我们把这种抽象称为logit-UFM.
这种配体将因丢失而直接引发的几何学与网络架构和共享模型参数引入的额外相互作用隔离开来,从而得出以下命题:

blocks.en: Under the logit-UFM assumptions, as the softmax outputs converge toward the vertices of the probability simplex during training, the corresponding logit vectors align with the directions defined in Eq. 2 .

At the end of training, the softmax outputs concentrate near the vertices of the probability simplex (colored area), while the logits exhibit a regular-simplex geometry (gray area) aligned with the same class prototype directions 𝐯 c k \mathbf{v}^{k}_{c} .

Analogously to the representation in Eq. 4 , we model each class distribution of the normalized logit representation with a vMF distribution ( Banerjee et al., 2005 ) whose mean direction is aligned with the class prototype 𝐯 c k \mathbf{v}^{k}_{c} .
Since both representations share the same prototype directions, the representation in Eq. 5 inherits the geometric properties discussed in Sec. 3.2.1 and can likewise be analyzed within the theoretical framework of Theorem 3.6 .
Compared with the representation derived by the softmax outputs as in Eq. 4 , the normalized logit representation exhibits a larger angular spread (see Fig. 2 ), preserving greater within-class variability, a property that has been associated with improved transferability and robustness of learned representations ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Wang & Isola, 2020 ) .

由于两种表述都具有相同的原型方向,Eq. 5的表述继承了Sec. 3.2.1所讨论的几何属性,同样可以在定理3.6的理论框架内进行分析.
与Eq. 4中软马克斯产出得出的表示值相比,正常的对数表示值显示出较大的角分布(见图2),保持了更大的阶级内变异性,这种财产与提高可转让性和强健的学习表示值有关(Chen等人,2022年;Wang & Isola,2020年)。

blocks.en:
To assess whether the behavior predicted by Prop. 3.3 emerges in standard neural networks, and to quantify the spread of the two representations, we leverage the NC hypotheses introduced by Papyan et al. (2020) .
These hypotheses provide a methodology for examining how the representations derived from softmax outputs and logits collapse toward the class prototype directions defined in Eq. 2 .
The NC hypotheses evaluate whether the within-class covariance tends to 0 (NC1); whether class means form a simplex whose vertices have the same norm (NC2 equinorm) and are maximally and equally distant from each other (NC2 equidistance); whether class means converge to class prototypes (NC3); and whether the nearest class-mean rule for classifying features holds (NC4).
blocks.zh:
来评估普罗普预测的行为. 3.3出现在标准神经网络中,为了量化两种表达方式的传播,我们利用了Papyan等人(2020年)提出的NC假设.
这些假设提供了一种方法,用以审查从软磁输出和对数中得出的表示如何向Eq.2所界定的类原型方向崩溃。
NC的假设评价了类内共变是否趋向于0(NC1);类的意思是否形成一个其顶点具有相同规范(NC2 equinorm)并且最大和同等距离(NC2 等距)的简单x;类的意思是否与类原型(NC3)汇合;以及最近的分类特征的类-类规则是否持有(NC4)。

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 reports the corresponding NC measures for softmax outputs (blue curves) and logits (orange curves) during the terminal phase of training of a ResNet-18 on CIFAR-100.
The higher NC1 values observed for logits indicate greater residual within-class variability than for softmax outputs.
Similarly, the higher NC2-equidistance and NC3 values indicate a lower degree of convergence of the logit representations toward the ideal simplex geometry and the corresponding class-prototype directions.
These results show that, while both representations exhibit the same underlying simplex structure, logits retain a larger within-class spread and a lower degree of prototype alignment than softmax outputs.
This distinct trade-off between alignment and spread is reflected in the retrieval performance reported in Sec. 4 .
Similar trends across different model architectures and datasets are reported in Appendix B .

In this section, we address the misalignment that arises in the proposed hyperspherical simplex representations when new classes are introduced during model updates, analyzing the behavior of the features through their class prototypes ( Papyan et al., 2020 ) .
We formally characterize this misalignment and introduce a deterministic linear transformation that restores prototype alignment across updates.

blocks.en: 3.4 Theoretical Analysis of the Backward-Compatibility Definition
blocks.zh: 3.4 向后兼容定义的理论分析

blocks.en: In the following, we establish geometric conditions under which the backward-compatibility inequalities hold in expectation, and then analyze whether these conditions are satisfied by the proposed hyperspherical simplex representations.
blocks.zh: 在下文中,我们规定了几何条件,在这种条件下,落后-相容性不平等在预期中存在,然后分析这些条件是否为拟议的超球形简单表示所满足。

blocks.en:
Consider hyperspherical representations obtained at update steps k k and t t , with t > k t>k .
Assume that (i) the features of each class c c are drawn independently from a von Mises–Fisher distribution vMF( 𝝁 c , κ c \bm{\mu}_{c},\kappa_{c} ) whose mean direction 𝛍 c \bm{\mu}_{c} is the corresponding class prototype, and (ii) the concentration κ c \kappa_{c} of each class distribution increases from step k k to step t t .
Then the compatibility inequalities of Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b are satisfied in expectation if (a) corresponding class prototypes are aligned across updates and (b) the angle between prototypes of different classes is greater than π / 2 \pi/2 .
blocks.zh:
考虑在更新步骤 k k 和 t t 中获得的超球面表示, t > k t > k.
假设(一)每个C类的特征是独立于一个 von Mises - Fisher 分布 vMF(μ c, obm\ mu}_{c},\kappa\c}),其平均方向 μ c\bm\ mu}_{c}是相应的类原型, (二) 每一类分布的浓度 → c\kappa\c} 从 step k k 到 step t 增加 。
然后,如果(a)对应的类原型在更新之间对齐,(b)不同类原型之间的角度大于 π / 2\pi/2,那么Eq 1a 和 Eq 1b 的兼容性不平等就会在预期中得到满足.

blocks.en:
The vMF distribution in assumption (i) is employed as a tractable modeling assumption rather than as an exact characterization of the learned distributions: it yields closed-form expressions for the expected cosine distances in Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b in terms of the prototype directions and concentration parameters (Lemma G.1 in Appendix G ), which enables the analytical characterization in Theorem 3.6 .
It provides a standard probabilistic model for directional data on the unit hypersphere ( Banerjee et al., 2005 ) , and hyperspherical and angular representations have been extensively investigated in deep classification and face recognition ( Liu et al., 2016 ; Liu et al., 2017 ; Deng et al., 2019 ) .
More broadly, vMF-based formulations have been employed to define hyperspherical latent-variable models ( Davidson et al., 2018 ) , learn discriminative hyperspherical representations ( Hasnat et al., 2017 ; Scott et al., 2021 ) , model normalized contrastive and hyperspherical features ( Du et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) , and characterize class-conditional latent structure in theoretical analyses of cross-entropy learning ( Reizinger et al., 2025 ) .
Remark 2 further clarifies the specific role of the vMF assumption and its first-moment characterization in the proof of Theorem 3.6 .
blocks.zh:
假设(一)中的 vMF 分布被作为可牵引的模型假设,而不是对所学到的分布进行精确的定性:它以原型方向和浓度参数(附录G中的Lemma G.1)对Eq. 1a和Eq. 1b的预期余弦距离产生封闭式表达式,从而可以在定理3.6中分析定性.
它为单位超层方向数据提供了标准概率模型(Banerjee等人,2005年),超球面和角面表示在深度分类和面部识别中得到了广泛的调查(刘等人,2016年;刘等人,2017年;邓等人,2019年).
更广泛地说,VMF配体被用于定义超球性潜变模型(Davidson等人,2018年),学习差异性超球性表达法(Hasnat等人,2017年;Scott等人,2021年),模型正常化的对比性和超球性特征(Du等人,2024年;Bai等人,2024年),并在交叉性学习的理论分析中描述类条件潜变结构(Reizer等人,2025年)。
说明2进一步澄清了vMF假设的具体作用及其在定理证明中的第一时刻特征. 3.6. .

blocks.en:
Assumption (ii), that class representations become increasingly concentrated around their prototypes across model updates, is supported by several complementary observations.
Scaling-law studies show that increasing model capacity or training data generally improves predictive, transfer, and retrieval performance ( Fang et al., 2024 ; Prato et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2022 ) , motivating the model-update scenarios considered here, in which updated models are more capable or trained on larger datasets.
Neural Collapse analyses provide a more direct geometric connection: within-class variability progressively decreases during training as features concentrate around their class means ( Papyan et al., 2020 ; Yaras et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) , and stronger collapse with reduced relative within-class variability is observed as network width and depth increase ( Yaras et al., 2022 ; Súkeník et al., 2025 ) .
Under the vMF modeling assumption, such a reduction in angular dispersion around the class prototype corresponds to an increase in the concentration parameter κ \kappa .
blocks.zh:
假设(二),类别表述越来越集中在模型更新的原型上,这得到若干补充观察的支持。
扩展法研究表明,提高模型能力或培训数据一般能提高预测性、转移性和检索性能(Fang等人, 2024年;Prato等人, 2021年;Zhai等人, 2022年),激发了本文所考虑的模型更新假设,其中更新模型在较大数据集上的能力或训练更强。
神经折叠分析提供了更直接的几何联系:在培训期间,随着特征集中在班内手段周围,班内变异性逐渐减少(Papyan等人,2020年;Yaras等人,2022年;Jiang等人,2024年),随着网络宽度和深度的扩大,观察到更强的崩溃,相对班内变异性减少(Yaras等人,2022年;Súkeník等人,2025年)。
在 vMF 模型假设下, 类原型周围角散射的这种减小, 相当于浓度参数 $\ kappa 的增大。

blocks.en:
These observations primarily concern penultimate-layer features, but they can be related to the output representations used by PSP and LSP.
For a linear classifier, variations in the backbone representations induce bounded variations in the corresponding logits ( Gouk et al., 2021 ) , and the progressive alignment between class means and classifier weights observed during training ( Papyan et al., 2020 ) relates the geometry of the penultimate-layer representations to that of the logits.
In Appendix H , we provide empirical evidence on CIFAR-10 that both logits and softmax outputs become increasingly concentrated around their class prototypes across model updates.
blocks.zh:
这些意见主要涉及倒数第二层特征,但可能与PSP和LSP所使用的输出表示有关.
对于线性分类器来说,骨干表示的变化诱导相应对数的定界变化(Gouk等人,2021年),在训练中观察到的班次手段和分类器权重的渐进对齐(Papyan等人,2020年)将倒数第二层表示的几何与对数的几何对齐.
在附录H中,我们提供了关于CIFAR-10的经验性证据表明,在模型更新中,对数和软最大输出越来越集中在其类原型上。

blocks.en: The aligned regular-simplex geometry centered at the origin, on which the proposed representations are built, satisfies the geometric conditions of Theorem 3.6 . The following corollary formalizes this result for any hyperspherical representation exhibiting this geometry.
blocks.zh: 以原产地为中心的对齐的正平方形几何,即拟议表述的基础,满足了定理3.6的几何条件. 以下的推论使这个结果正式化,对于任何显示这种几何的超球形表示.

blocks.en: Under the assumptions of Theorem 3.6 , hyperspherical representations whose class prototypes form a regular simplex centered at the origin and remain aligned across updates satisfy the compatibility inequalities of Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b in expectation.
blocks.zh: 根据定理3.6的假设,其类原型形成以原型为中心且在更新间保持对齐的常态的超球形表示满足预期中的Eq 1a和Eq 1b的兼容性不平等.

blocks.en:
This follows from the geometry of a regular simplex centered at the origin, where the inner product between any two distinct normalized class prototypes is negative, implying a pairwise angle greater than π / 2 \pi/2 ( Pernici et al., 2021a ) . Hence, once corresponding class prototypes are aligned across updates, both geometric conditions required by Theorem 3.6 hold.
Remark 3 in Appendix G further clarifies the relation between this geometry and the Simplex ETF configuration arising in Neural Collapse.
blocks.zh:
其来源于以原产地为中心的一种普通的简单x的几何图案,其中任何两种不同的普通类原型之间的内产物都是负的,意味着一个双向角大于 / 2\pi/2(Pernici等人,2021a). 因此,一旦相应的类原型在各种更新之间对齐,定理3.6所要求具备的两个几何条件.
附录中的注3 G进一步澄清了这种几何学和神经折叠中产生的Simplex ETF配置之间的关系.

blocks.en:
The proposed PSP and LSP representations satisfy the geometric hypotheses of Corollary 3.7 .
Their class prototypes form a regular simplex centered at the origin: for PSP, by construction (Sec. 3.2.1 ); for LSP, exactly under the logit-UFM assumptions of Prop. 3.3 , with the emergence of this geometry in neural networks assessed empirically through the Neural Collapse analysis of Sec. 3.2.2 .
Corresponding prototypes remain aligned across updates when the class set is unchanged, while under class expansion the transformation 𝐏 t , k \mathbf{P}_{t,k} restores their alignment (Prop. 3.5 ).
Therefore, under the assumptions of Theorem 3.6 , PSP and LSP satisfy the compatibility inequalities of Eq. 1a and Eq. 1b in expectation.
In Appendix I , we empirically isolate the two operations underlying PSP in a class-expansion update, showing that positive average margins for both compatibility inequalities are obtained only when the centering projection and the angular correction are combined.
blocks.zh:
拟议的PSP和LSP表述满足了Comrollary 3.7的几何假设.
他们的类原型形成一个以原产地为中心的普通的简单x:为PSP,通过构造(Sec. 3.2.1);为LSP,恰好在Prop.3.3的logit-UFM假设下,这种几何在神经网络中的出现通过神经折叠分析Sec. 3.2.2进行经验评估.
对应的原型在类集不变时仍然在全更新间对齐,而在类扩展下,转换的P t, k\ mathbf{P}_{t,k}恢复它们的对齐(prop. 3.5).
因此,根据定理3.6的假设,PSP和LSP满足预期中的Eq 1a和Eq 1b的兼容性不平等.
在附录一中,我们从经验上将PSP基础的两个操作在类扩展更新中隔离开来,表明只有当中心投影和角修正结合时,两个兼容性不平等的正平均值才会得到.

blocks.en: The theoretical result is not specific to PSP and LSP: Corollary 3.7 also applies, for instance, to representations learned with pre-allocated d d -simplex fixed classifiers ( Biondi et al., 2023a ; Biondi et al., 2024 ; Biondi et al., 2026 ) , whose class prototypes are fixed a priori and thus remain aligned across updates. From a practical perspective, however, PSP and LSP do not require a shared pre-allocated fixed classifier across model updates.
blocks.zh: 理论结果并不针对PSP和LSP: 例如,Corollary 3.7也适用于使用预先分配的d-simpex固定分类器(Biondi等人,2023年a;Biondi等人,2024年;Biondi等人,2026年)获得的表述,其类原型是先验的,因此在各种更新中保持一致。 然而,从实用的角度来看,PSP和LSP不需要在模型更新中共享预先分配的固定分类器.

blocks.en: 3.5 Scalability via Top- k k Sparsification
blocks.zh: 3.5 通过Top-k k 的可伸缩性

blocks.en:
Hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs (Eq. 4 for PSP) or logits (Eq. 5 for LSP) have dimensionality equal to the number of classes.
Although training on a larger number of classes can improve the quality and transferability of learned representations ( Zhu et al., 2022 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) , this class-dependent dimensionality poses a limitation in large-scale retrieval scenarios: the memory required to store the gallery scales linearly with both the number of gallery samples and the number of classes, potentially becoming prohibitive at scale.
To address this, we construct sparse representations by retaining only the highest-ranked components of each feature vector, a choice motivated by the top- k k calibration of the softmax cross-entropy loss and the rank-preserving property of the softmax function ( Lapin et al., 2016 ; Yang & Koyejo, 2020 ) .

由软max输出(Eq. 4 for PSP)或logits(Eq. 5 for LSP)衍生出来的超球形简单x表示法,其维度等于类数.

为了解决这个问题,我们通过只保留每个特性矢量中排名最高的成分来构建稀疏的表示方式,这种选择的动机是软马克思跨直径损失的顶- k 校准和软马克思函数的保级属性(Lapin等人,2016年;Yang & Koyejo,2020年)。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: Building on the theoretical analysis, in this section we examine whether the backward-compatibility properties of PSP and LSP are reflected empirically across various model-update scenarios, under established training protocols and retrieval-based evaluation procedures.
blocks.zh: 根据理论分析,在本节中,我们审查根据既定的训练规程和基于检索的评价程序,在各种模型更新的情景中,是否从经验上反映了PSP和LSP的落后兼容性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setting

blocks.en: 4.2 Standard Compatibility Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 标准兼容性基准

blocks.en: In this section, we compare PSP and LSP with established backward-compatibility methods on standard compatibility benchmarks. Following prior work ( Shen et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ; Meng et al., 2021 ; Biondi et al., 2023a ; Pan et al., 2023 ) , we evaluate three update scenarios: extended classes , where new classes are introduced across model updates; extended backbone , where the model architecture is upgraded; and extended classes and backbone , where both changes occur simultaneously.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们将PSP和LSP与标准兼容性基准上既定的落后兼容性方法进行比较. 继先前的工作(沈等,2020年;周等,2023年;孟等,2021年;比翁迪等,2023年a;潘等,2023年),我们评价三种更新方案:扩展班,跨模式更新引入新班;扩展骨干,示范架构升级;扩展班和骨干,两者同时发生.

blocks.en:
Following Shen et al. (2020) and subsequent literature, unless otherwise specified, each updated model is randomly initialized and trained from scratch rather than initialized from the previous model.
This protocol removes parameter inheritance across model updates, ensuring that observed compatibility cannot be attributed to warm-starting from a previously learned representation.
Models are trained using classification as the surrogate task for representation learning.
Implementation details for the standard compatibility benchmarks are provided in Appendix J .
blocks.zh:
接下来 沈等人(2020年)和后来的文献,除非另有说明,每款更新的模型都是随机初始化的,从零开始训练,而不是从之前的模型中初始化.
这个协议删除了整个模型更新的参数继承,确保所观察到的兼容性不能归结于从先前学到的表示器中温和的启动.
模式培训采用分类作为代表学习的替代任务。
标准兼容性基准的执行细节见附录J。

blocks.en:
We compare against the following backward-compatibility methods: BCT ( Shen et al., 2020 ) , RACT ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) , AdvBCT ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , LCE ( Meng et al., 2021 ) , and CoReS ( Biondi et al., 2023a ) .
We also include a Baseline based on the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized encoder features without any compatible method applied. When the encoder feature dimensionality differs across model updates, the lower-dimensional representation is zero-padded to match the dimensionality of the higher-dimensional one before computing cross-model similarities.
For reproducibility, we use the official publicly available implementations of all compared methods.
All experiments are conducted on two NVIDIA A100 40 GB GPUs.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Extended Classes Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 扩展类别基准

blocks.en:
In the extended-classes benchmark, the training set of each dataset is partitioned into T T sequential tasks, each introducing a disjoint and equal number of new classes.
At each update step t t , the model is trained from scratch using the cumulative training data from tasks 1 1 through t t .
Following Zhou et al. (2023) ; Ricci et al. (2024) ; Jaeckle et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2022) , retrieval is evaluated at each update step over the entire test set, including classes that have not yet been observed during training.
This results in a semi-open-set evaluation scenario, in which the training class set expands across updates while retrieval is performed over the complete set of classes.
Tab. 1 reports AC , AA , and ACA on CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) using a ResNet-18 backbone.
Tab. 2 reports the same metrics on larger-scale datasets: ImageNet-1K ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) using a ResNet-50 backbone and Google Landmarks v2 ( Weyand et al., 2020 ) using a ResNet-18 backbone initialized from ImageNet-1K pretrained weights at every update step.
Overall, Tab. 1 and Tab. 2 show that PSP and LSP achieve competitive retrieval performance while consistently providing strong compatibility across model updates.
The advantage of our proposed representations over the compared approaches becomes increasingly pronounced as the number of update steps increases, as reflected by the compatibility metrics in the 50-step setting on CIFAR-100 and the 5-step setting on ImageNet-1K.
The compatibility matrices for the 5-step CIFAR-100 experiment are reported in Fig. 9 in Appendix K , providing a visual summary of retrieval performance across model updates.

blocks.en:
In the 2-step setting, where compatibility is evaluated over a single model-update pair, several of the compared approaches achieve strong performance.
On CIFAR-100, BCT, RACT, LCE, CoReS, PSP, and LSP all satisfy the empirical compatibility criterion ( A ​ C = 1 AC=1 ), with RACT achieving the highest retrieval performance among the compared methods.
A similar behavior is observed on ImageNet-1K, where BCT, RACT, PSP, and LSP satisfy the compatibility criterion, while RACT obtains the highest AA and ACA .
On Google Landmarks v2, BCT, AdvBCT, LCE, PSP, and LSP satisfy the criterion, whereas RACT does not.
In contrast, the Baseline based directly on the encoder features does not achieve compatibility in any evaluated setting, showing that independently trained encoder representations are not naturally compatible across model updates.

On CIFAR-100, the compatibility of BCT, RACT, AdvBCT, and LCE drops to nearly zero in the 20- and 50-step settings.

A similar trend is observed in the 5-step ImageNet-1K benchmark: although several competing methods retain high AA , their compatibility frequency is low or zero, whereas PSP achieves A ​ C = 1 AC=1 and A ​ C ​ A = 31.09 ACA=31.09 , and LSP achieves A ​ C = 0.50 AC=0.50 and A ​ C ​ A = 14.28 ACA=14.28 .

blocks.en:
One possible explanation for the degradation observed for several of the compared methods as the number of updates increases is that regularization- and mapping-based approaches typically establish compatibility only with respect to the previous model.
When such compatibility is enforced sequentially across multiple updates, deviations and misalignment with respect to earlier model versions may accumulate because compatibility with all previous representations is not directly enforced.
Rather than sequentially enforcing compatibility with their predecessors, PSP and LSP exploit a regular-simplex geometry that provides a common reference across all model updates, consistently with Corollary 3.7 .

随着更新数量的增加,对若干比较方法观察到的退化,一个可能的解释是,基于正规化和绘图的方法通常只与以前的模型相匹配。
当这种兼容性在多个更新之间相继执行时,由于与以前所有表达的兼容性没有直接执行,因此与早期模型版本的偏差和错配可能会累积.
PSP和LSP与其前身相继执行兼容性,而是利用一种常规的-simpex几何,在所有模型更新中提供共同的参考,与Corollary 3.7. 一致.

blocks.en:
Among the compared approaches, CoReS ( Biondi et al., 2023a ) is conceptually closer to PSP and LSP, as it also exploits a regular-simplex geometry as reference across model updates.
The main practical distinction is that CoReS requires the classifier geometry and the number of prototypes to be pre-allocated before training, including prototypes reserved for classes that may be introduced in future updates ( Pernici et al., 2021b ; Biondi et al., 2023a ) .
The outputs reserved for future classes participate in the cross-entropy objective from the beginning of training and act as negative classes for current samples ( Pernici et al., 2021b ; Biondi et al., 2023a ) , thereby constraining representation learning with respect to a prototype geometry and class capacity specified in advance.
This fixed pre-allocated prototype assignment may limit adaptation to the observed class structure ( Saadabadi et al., 2024 ) .
In contrast, PSP and LSP derive their reference geometry directly from the output space of each model.
Furthermore, CoReS scales poorly with the number of classes, as its memory requirements, driven by both the pre-allocated fixed classifier and the additional linear layer mapping the backbone features to the simplex representation space, grow substantially with the class count. For Google Landmarks v2, these requirements made training computationally infeasible under our experimental configuration, and CoReS results are therefore not reported in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh:
在比较的方法中,CoReS(Biondi等人,2023a)在概念上更接近于PSP和LSP,因为它还利用一个普通的几何来作为模型更新的参考.
主要的实际区别是CoReS要求分级几何和在培训前预先分配的原型数量,包括预留用于未来更新中可能引入的班级的原型(Pernici等人,2021b;Biondi等人,2023a).
为未来班级预留的产出从培训开始就参与跨课程目标,并作为当前样本的负面课目(Pernici等人,2021b;Biondi等人,2023a),从而制约了对预先指定的几何学原型和班级能力的表达学习。
这种固定的预分配原型分配可能会限制对观测到的类结构的适应(Saadabadi等人,2024年)。
相比之下,PSP和LSP直接从每个模型的输出空间中得出它们的参考几何.
此外,CoReS在预先分配的固定分类器和将主干特征映射到simplex代表空间的额外线性层的驱动下,其内存要求与类数相比,其规模差,随类数而大幅增长。 对于Google Landmarks v2, 这些要求使得在我们的实验配置下在计算上无法进行训练,因此CoReS的结果在Tab中没有报告. 2 (英语).

Notably, across the different numbers of update steps reported in Tab. 1 and Tab. 2 , LSP consistently achieves higher AA than PSP, while its AC is generally equal to or lower than that of PSP.
This behavior is consistent with the larger within-class spread and lower prototype alignment of LSP observed in the NC analysis of Sec. 3.2.2 .
As a result of this trade-off, LSP often achieves comparable or higher ACA . blocks.en: 4.2.2 Extended Backbone Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 扩展后骨基准

blocks.en:
In this experimental setting, we maintain the same dataset across all update steps (with no introduction of additional classes during model updates) while increasing model architectural complexity across two steps (i.e., ResNet-18 → \rightarrow ResNet-50).
The goal is to evaluate compatibility when model updates involve a change in model architecture rather than the introduction of new training classes.
Results for CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1K are summarized in Tab. 4 .
Most of the evaluated approaches satisfy the compatibility criterion ( AC = 1 =1 ), suggesting that compatibility is generally easier to maintain in this setting than in the extended-classes benchmark.
Since this benchmark consists of two update steps, AC is determined by a single cross-model comparison, and performance differences therefore emerge primarily in terms of AA and ACA .
LSP achieves the highest AA and ACA on CIFAR-100 and remains within 0.1 0.1 – 0.2 0.2 percentage points of the best-performing methods, CoReS and RACT, on ImageNet-1K.
These results indicate that LSP maintains strong compatibility and retrieval performance even when the model architecture changes substantially.
Notably, PSP and LSP achieve competitive performance without requiring compatibility-specific regularization, learnable mappings, or modifications to the model architecture.
blocks.zh:
在这个实验环境中,我们对所有更新步骤都保持同样的数据集(在模型更新过程中没有引入额外的类),同时通过两个步骤(即ResNet-18 ~\rightarrow ResNet-50)来增加模型建筑的复杂性.
目标是在模型更新涉及模型架构变化而不是引入新的培训课程时评价兼容性.
CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1K的结果摘要载于Tab。 4 (英语).
大部分被评价的方法都符合兼容性标准(AC=1=1),说明在此设定中,与扩展类基准相比,兼容性一般更容易维持.
由于这一基准由两个更新步骤组成,因此AC是由单一的跨模型比较决定的,因此性能差异主要出现在AA和ACA.
LSP在CIFAR-100上实现了最高的AA和ACA,并且保持在0.1–0.2百分点内,在ImageNet-1K上表现最好的方法CoReS和RAT.
这些结果显示,LSP即使在模型架构发生实质性变化时仍保持强烈的兼容性和检索性能.
值得注意的是,PSP和LSP实现竞争性的性能,而不需要针对兼容性的规范化,可学习的绘图,或对模型架构的修改.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Extended Classes and Backbone Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 扩展类和背骨基准

blocks.en:
This experimental configuration, consisting of two update steps, combines the two previously examined update mechanisms: at the second step, the model is retrained from scratch on an expanded training set using a more expressive backbone.
Results for this combined setting are reported in Tab. 4 for the CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1K datasets.
The Baseline, which does not employ any compatibility-preservation mechanism, fails to satisfy the compatibility criterion ( AC = 0 =0 ) on both datasets, consistent with the behavior observed in the previous experimental settings.
In contrast, all evaluated backward-compatibility approaches, including PSP and LSP, satisfy the criterion ( AC = 1 =1 ), showing that compatibility can be maintained even when the model update simultaneously introduces new classes and changes the backbone architecture.
Across both CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1K, LSP shows robust performance under this combined update setting, achieving AA and ACA values that match or closely approach those of the strongest compared methods.
PSP also satisfies the compatibility criterion on both datasets, but attains lower AA and ACA than LSP.
This behavior is consistent with the smaller within-class spread of the softmax output representation observed in the Neural Collapse analysis of Sec. 3.2.2 , which may reduce retrieval performance in the semi-open-set setting, where the test set also contains classes not yet observed during training.

blocks.en: 4.3 Compatibility Across Independently Trained Models From Public Repositories
blocks.zh: 4.3 从公共仓库独立培训的模型的兼容性

blocks.en:
The standard compatibility benchmarks of Sec. 4.2 consider models explicitly trained within a backward-compatibility protocol.
Here, we evaluate a complementary and more practical setting in which compatibility is measured directly between independently trained models obtained from a public repository, without any additional compatibility-specific training or adaptation.
blocks.zh:
Sec.4.2的标准兼容性基准考虑在后向兼容性协议中明确培训的模型.
在此,我们评价一种补充和更加实际的环境,在这种环境中,直接衡量从公共储存库获得的经过独立培训的模型之间的兼容性,而无需进行任何额外的针对兼容性的培训或调整。

blocks.en:
We consider two sequences of pretrained models from the publicly available torchvision repository ( Marcel & Rodriguez, 2010 ) : a convolutional and hybrid sequence comprising AlexNet ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ) , ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) , RegNetX_3.2GF ( Radosavovic et al., 2020 ) , ResNet-152 ( He et al., 2016 ) , and MaxViT_T ( Tu et al., 2022 ) , and a transformer sequence comprising ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) .
All models are pretrained on ImageNet-1K while differing substantially in architecture and representational capacity.

在ImageNet-1K上,所有模型都经过预先培训,但结构和代表能力却大不相同。

blocks.en:
We evaluate retrieval on the ImageNet-1K test set, which follows the pretraining distribution (closed-set), and on Places365 ( Zhou et al., 2017 ) , whose classes and data distribution differ from those used for pretraining (open-set).
We compare PSP and LSP with the Baseline introduced in Sec. 4.2 , obtained by ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalizing the encoder features.
Existing backward-compatibility methods are not included because they require additional training, adaptation, or architectural modifications and therefore cannot be directly applied to these publicly available, independently trained models.

blocks.en:
The results in Tab. 5 show a clear advantage of the proposed hyperspherical simplex representations over the Baseline.
PSP provides highly consistent compatibility across the evaluated model sequences, attaining AC = 1 =1 in three of the four settings and AC = 0.90 =0.90 in the remaining open-set setting.
LSP also substantially improves compatibility over the Baseline, although it satisfies the empirical compatibility criterion for a smaller fraction of model-update pairs.
The compatibility matrices in Fig. 5 illustrate these differences: LSP and the Baseline achieve comparable same-model retrieval performance along the main diagonal, but the Baseline fails to maintain this performance across model updates, resulting in AC = 0 =0 .
A different trade-off between PSP and LSP emerges in closed-set and open-set evaluation.
On ImageNet-1K, corresponding to the same data distribution used to pretrain all models, PSP consistently achieves higher AC , AA , and ACA than LSP.
This behavior is consistent with the stronger alignment of PSP representations with the regular-simplex geometry and their lower within-class spread discussed in Sec. 3.2.2 .
On Places365, whose data distribution differs from the pretraining one, LSP instead achieves higher AA than PSP for both model sequences.
This result is consistent with the broader angular spread of LSP representations, which may provide greater flexibility under domain shift.
However, PSP retains substantially higher compatibility in this setting, achieving AC = 0.90 =0.90 and 1.00 1.00 , compared with 0.20 0.20 and 0.33 0.33 for LSP, and consequently also obtains higher ACA .

blocks.en:
Overall, these experiments show that PSP and LSP can substantially improve cross-model retrieval compatibility even between models that were not explicitly trained to be compatible.
PSP provides the most consistent empirical compatibility, whereas LSP preserves strong retrieval accuracy and achieves higher open-set AA , at the cost of lower compatibility than PSP.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,这些实验表明,PSP和LSP可以大大改进跨模型检索兼容性,即使是在未经过明确训练的模型之间也可以进行兼容.
PSP提供了最一致的经验兼容性,而LSP则保持了强的检索精度,并实现了更高的开集AA.,其代价是兼容性低于PSP.

blocks.en:
These results reflect a structural property of the proposed representations: their common reference is determined by the label space rather than by any interaction between models.
Models trained on the same set of classes under the standard class-indexing convention of a dataset, as is the case for all torchvision models trained on ImageNet-1K, induce the same one-hot encoding and therefore share the same reference geometry, without requiring coordination during training or access to previous models.
Complementary compatibility matrices for the open-set evaluation and the ViT model sequence are reported in Appendix L .
blocks.zh:
这些结果反映了拟议表述的结构属性:其共同的参考依据是标签空间,而不是模型之间的任何相互作用。
根据一套数据集标准课程索引惯例对同一组课程进行训练的模型,例如所有在ImageNet-1K上训练的火炬视觉模型,诱导相同的一热编码,因此共用同样的参考几何,而不需要在训练期间进行协调或访问以前的模型。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs (PSP) and logits (LSP) for backward-compatible retrieval.
The proposed representations leverage the simplex structure induced in the model output space by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot encoded class labels, which provides a common geometric reference that aligns corresponding class prototypes across model updates, without requiring compatibility-specific losses, learned mapping functions, a shared pre-allocated fixed classifier, or modifications to the model architecture.
When new classes are introduced, the resulting change in simplex geometry is compensated by a deterministic linear transformation that restores the alignment of the prototypes of previously observed classes.
We provide a theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility inequalities, showing that, under a von Mises–Fisher model with class concentration increasing across updates, they are satisfied in expectation if corresponding class prototypes are aligned across updates and prototypes of different classes form angles greater than π / 2 \pi/2 .
Aligned regular-simplex representations centered at the origin satisfy both conditions; since PSP instantiates this geometry by construction and LSP under the logit-UFM, both satisfy the compatibility inequalities in expectation.
We show that PSP and LSP achieve competitive retrieval performance on standard backward-compatibility benchmarks, with particularly high compatibility in scenarios involving many model updates.
Experiments further demonstrate that the proposed representations improve cross-model retrieval compatibility between independently trained models obtained from a public repository, without any additional adaptation.
Finally, we introduce a top- k k sparsification strategy motivated by the rank-preserving property of the softmax to address the linear growth of the representation dimensionality with the number of classes.
Across the evaluated settings, top- k k sparsification substantially reduces representation storage, with negligible changes in retrieval accuracy and without degrading compatibility, supporting the use of PSP and LSP in large-scale retrieval scenarios.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了从软磁输出(PSP)和对数(LSP)中衍生出来的超球形简单x表示,用于后向兼容检索.
提议的表示法利用了模型输出空间中由软马克跨内涵训练所诱导的,带有单热编码的类标签的简单x结构,它提供了一个常见的几何参考物,使相应的类原型在模型更新中相互配合,而不需要兼容性特定损失,学习的绘图功能,共享的预分配固定分类器,或者对模型架构的修改.
当引入新的类时,由此带来的简单x几何学的改变被定型线性转变所补偿,这种转变恢复了以前观测到的类的原型的对齐.
我们对形式上的落后-相容性不平等进行了理论分析,显示在von Mises-Fisher模型下,如果相应的类原型在各种不同类形式角度的更新和原型之间比 / 2\pi/2 更大,那么它们就会满足。
以原产地为中心的对齐的正则-simpex表示方式满足了这两个条件;由于PSP通过构建即时化这种几何图形,而LSP则在logit-UFM下,两者都满足了期望中的兼容性不平等.
我们显示,PSP和LSP在标准后向兼容性基准上实现竞争性检索性能,在涉及许多模型更新的情景中具有特别高的兼容性.
实验进一步表明,拟议的表述改进了从公共储存库获得的独立培训模型之间的跨模型检索兼容性,而无需作任何额外的修改。
最后,我们推行了一种顶级-k k 螺旋化战略,其动机是软马克思的保级属性,以解决代表维度与类数的线性增长.
在整个评估的设置中,顶-k spursization大大降低了表示存储量,在检索准确性方面变化微乎其微,且不降低兼容性,支持在大规模检索的情况下使用PSP和LSP.

blocks.en:
Limitations. PSP and LSP rely on the simplex structure induced in the model output space by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot encoded class labels.
This requirement limits the direct applicability of our approach to models trained with alternative objectives, such as self-supervised pretraining without explicit classification heads or regression-based formulations.
However, this constraint can be mitigated by training a linear classifier on top of a frozen pretrained encoder using a modest amount of external labeled data (see Appendix L.1 ), with limited computational overhead since only the classifier is optimized.
blocks.zh:
限制。 PSP和LSP依赖于在模型输出空间中由软马克斯跨内线训练诱导的单热编码类标签的简单x结构.
这一要求限制了我们的做法直接适用于接受其他目标培训的模型,例如没有明确分类头目或回归式表述的自我监督的预训。
然而,通过使用少量的外部标注数据(见附录L.1)在被冻结的预装编码器之上培训线性分类器,可以减轻这种制约,因为只有分类器才得到优化,因此计算间接费用有限.

blocks.en:
A second limitation concerns the consistency of the label space across model updates: our method assumes that the mapping between each class label and its output index remains unchanged.
Changes in class ordering or label definitions would disrupt the geometric correspondence on which the backward-compatibility of the proposed representations relies.
A reordering of the classes can be undone by a fixed permutation of the output coordinates, provided that the correspondence between old and new indices is known.
Moreover, model updates are commonly driven by additional samples for existing classes or by the introduction of new classes, corresponding to the domain-incremental and class-incremental scenarios of incremental learning ( Van de Ven et al., 2022 ; Lin et al., 2021 ) and to the update settings considered in backward-compatible representation learning ( Shen et al., 2020 ) ; in both cases, the existing class indices are preserved.
blocks.zh:
第二个限制涉及整个模型更新的标签空间的一致性:我们的方法假定每个类标签与其输出指数之间的映射保持不变。
类别顺序或标签定义的改变将破坏拟议表述的落后兼容性所依赖的几何对应。
如果已知新旧指数之间的对应关系,对产出坐标进行固定的排列就可以解除对类的重新排序。
此外,模型更新通常由现有班级的附加样本或引入新班级驱动,对应增量学习的域-递增和类-递增假想(Van de Ven等人,2022年;Lin等人,2021年)以及后向兼容性代表学习中考虑的更新设置(Shen等人,2020年);在这两种情况中,都保留了现有的班级指数.

blocks.en:
Finally, our theoretical analysis relies on modeling assumptions, namely von Mises–Fisher class distributions and increasing concentration across updates, which provide a tractable approximation of learned representations rather than an exact characterization, so that the resulting guarantees hold in expectation under these assumptions.
Empirically, PSP and LSP nonetheless substantially improve compatibility across the evaluated settings, indicating that the identified geometric conditions are informative in practice.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们的理论分析依赖于模型假设,即von Mises-Fisher类分布和各种更新的日益集中,这些更新提供了对所学表现的可操作性近似而非准确的定性,从而使由此产生的保证维持在这些假设下的预期。
经验是,PSP和LSP仍然大大改进了各评价环境的兼容性,表明所查明的几何条件在实践中是翔实的。

blocks.en: Broader Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en:
Backward-compatible retrieval can reduce the computational, storage, and environmental costs associated with repeatedly re-indexing large galleries.
However, retaining legacy representations may also preserve biases or limitations inherited from earlier models, training data, or gallery composition.
Moreover, aggregate compatibility metrics do not guarantee uniform performance across subpopulations.
Future work should therefore consider disaggregated compatibility measures and establish when gallery re-indexing is preferable to preserving compatibility, particularly after updates intended to correct bias, modify class semantics, remove previously learned information, or address substantial distribution shifts.
blocks.zh:
背向兼容的检索可以降低与反复重新索引大型画廊相关的计算,存储和环境成本.
然而,保留遗留的表述也可能保留先前的模型、培训数据或画廊组成的偏见或限制。
此外,总的兼容性衡量标准不能保证各亚人群的一致业绩。
因此,今后的工作应考虑分门别类的兼容性措施,并确定何时画廊重新索引比保持兼容性更为可取,特别是在旨在纠正偏差、修改类语义、删除以前学到的信息或处理大量分布变化的更新之后。

blocks.en:
This appendix describes how PSP and LSP are integrated into a retrieval system.
Importantly, PSP and LSP are two alternative feature definitions, not post-hoc transformations to be applied to arbitrary embeddings after deployment.
Whether to use features derived from softmax outputs (PSP, Eq. 4 ) or logits (LSP, Eq. 5 ) must therefore be chosen before the first deployment of the retrieval system and then used consistently to build the gallery index and process future queries.
Accordingly, gallery items are indexed once using the chosen representation and stored in the retrieval database.

重要的是,PSP和LSP是两个备选的特征定义,而不是适用于部署后任意嵌入的后热转换.
因此,无论是使用软max输出(PSP, Eq. 4)还是登录(LSP, Eq. 5)生成的特性,都必须在首次部署检索系统之前选择,然后一致地用于构建画廊索引和处理未来的查询.
因此,画廊项目一旦使用所选的表示方式编制索引并储存在检索数据库中。

Alg. 1 is used to define and store gallery features when the retrieval system is first deployed.
If, after a model update, the gallery is fully re-indexed, the same algorithm is simply applied again to all gallery items using the updated model and the same chosen representation type.
By contrast, Alg. 2 is used only in the backward-compatible retrieval setting, where the gallery remains fixed at step k k and only the incoming queries are processed by the updated model at step t t .

blocks.en: The regular-simplex geometry considered in Corollary 3.7 is closely related to the Simplex ETF structure arising in Neural Collapse ( Papyan et al., 2020 ) . Within a single representation space, Neural Collapse characterizes the centered class means as approaching a Simplex ETF configuration, in which the normalized class prototypes have constant pairwise inner products 𝝁 i ⊤ ​ 𝝁 j = − 1 C − 1 , i ≠ j , \bm{\mu}_{i}^{\top}\bm{\mu}_{j}=-\frac{1}{C-1},\qquad i\neq j, and therefore pairwise angles greater than π / 2 \pi/2 .
blocks.zh: Corollary 3.7中考虑的常态-simplex几何与神经折叠产生的Simplex ETF结构(Papyan等人,2020年)密切相关. 在单一的表示空间内,神经折叠将中心类的表示特征描述为接近Simplex ETF配置,其中正态类原型具有恒配对内产物μ i → μ j = − 1 C → 1, i → j ,\bm\ mu\ i top\ bm\ mu\ j\ frac{ 1},\qquad i\ neq j,因此双配角大于 → / 2\pi/2 .

blocks.en: This within-model geometric property, however, does not by itself imply alignment across independently obtained representation spaces. In particular, the Simplex ETF geometry is invariant under a common orthogonal transformation: applying the same orthogonal transformation to all prototypes preserves their norms and pairwise inner products while changing their absolute orientation. Consequently, two models may independently exhibit the same Simplex ETF geometry while their corresponding class prototypes are not aligned across updates.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种模型内几何属性本身并不意味着在独立获得的代表空间之间保持一致。 特别是Simplex ETF几何在常见的正交变换下是不可变的:对所有原型进行相同的正交变换,保留其规范,对偶的内产物同时改变其绝对方向. 因此,两种模型可能独立显示相同的Simplex ETF几何,而其相应的类原型则不会在更新之间对齐.

blocks.en: Thus, the Simplex ETF property guarantees the obtuse inter-class geometry required by Theorem 3.6 , but not the cross-update alignment of corresponding prototypes. When this additional alignment condition is satisfied, and under the vMF and increasing-concentration assumptions of Theorem 3.6 , an aligned Simplex ETF configuration falls within the regular-simplex setting of Corollary 3.7 and therefore satisfies the compatibility inequalities in expectation.
blocks.zh: 因此,Simplex ETF属性保证了定理3.6所要求的偏移级间几何,但不保证对应原型的交叉更新对齐. 当满足了这个额外的对齐条件,并且根据定理3.6的vMF和日益集中的假设,一个对齐的Simplex ETF配置属于Corrollary 3.7的常规-简单设置,因此满足了期望中的兼容性不平等.

blocks.en:
Extended Classes Scenario. In this scenario, we investigate the concentration of the representations when the number of classes is expanded during a model update. The old model is trained on the first 5 classes of CIFAR-10, and the updated model is trained on the complete set of 10 classes. Both models use a ResNet-18 architecture ( He et al., 2016 ) trained for 100 epochs using stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with an initial learning rate of 0.1, momentum of 0.9, and a cosine annealing learning rate schedule.
The results shown in Fig. 8 demonstrate that both the logits and the softmax outputs of the updated model are more concentrated than those of the old model for all 10 classes. This is consistent with the semi-open-set scenario, where the new classes are unknown to the old model but are known to the updated model, thus explaining the significant gap in concentration in the last 5 classes. The increase in concentration also holds for the 5 shared classes, on which both models are already highly concentrated, supporting the assumption of increasing concentration with class expansion during model updates.

blocks.en: L.1 Extension to Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Encoders via Linear Probing
blocks.zh: L.1 通过线性测试向自我监督的和视觉语言编码器扩展

blocks.en: In addition to supervised ImageNet-pretrained classifiers from torchvision ( Paszke et al., 2019 ; Marcel & Rodriguez, 2010 ) , we extend our analysis to self-supervised pretrained encoders and pretrained vision-language models in a linear-probe setting. Specifically, we consider two families of publicly available pretrained models: (i) three checkpoints from the DINO family, namely DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) , DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , and DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , obtained from the Hugging Face Hub ( Wolf et al., 2019 ) ; and (ii) three CLIP variants pretrained by OpenAI, namely ViT-B/32, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/14, obtained from the OpenCLIP repository ( Ilharco et al., 2021 ) . In all cases, the image encoder is used as a frozen feature extractor.
blocks.zh: 除了从火炬视觉(Paszke等人,2019年;Marcel & Rodriguez,2010年)中被监督的ImageNet预训分类器外,我们还将分析扩展至线性测试环境中的自我监督预训编码器和预训的视觉语言模型. 具体地说,我们认为,有两个家庭是公开使用的预先训练过的型号:(一) DINO家族的三个检查站,即DINO(Caron等人,2021年),DINOv2(Oquab等人,2023年)和DINOv3(Siméoni等人,2026年),取自Hugging Face Hub(Wolf等人,2019年);(二) OpenAI预先训练的三种CLIP变体,即OpenCLIP寄存器(Ilharco等人,2021年)。 在所有情况下,图像编码器都被用作冷冻特性提取器.

blocks.en: For each checkpoint, we train a bias-free linear classifier on top of the extracted features using ImageNet-1K as the training set for 30 epochs, while keeping the encoder weights frozen. We then construct PSP and LSP representations from the resulting classifier outputs, using softmax outputs and logits, respectively. As a baseline, we directly use the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized encoder output without any additional training. Retrieval performance is evaluated on the ImageNet-1K test set, following the same protocol adopted in the main benchmark.
blocks.zh: 对于每个检查站,我们用ImageNet-1K作为30个纪元的训练集,在抽取的特性之上训练一个无偏斜线性分类器,同时保持编码器重量的冻结. 然后,我们从产生的分类器输出中构建PSP和LSP表示,分别使用软最大输出和对数. 作为基线,我们直接使用l 2\ell\\2} - 规范化编码器输出而无需任何额外的训练. 检索性能在ImageNet-1K测试集上评价,遵循主基准所采用的相同协议.

blocks.en: Tab. 7 summarizes the compatibility results obtained in this linear-probe setting on ImageNet-1K. For both DINO and CLIP model families, PSP and LSP achieve substantially higher compatibility metrics than the baseline, confirming that the proposed framework can be extended beyond standard supervised classifiers.
blocks.zh: Tab. 7总结了在ImageNet-1K上的线性探测设置中取得的兼容结果. 对DINO和CLIP模型家族来说,PSP和LSP实现的兼容性度量比基线要高得多,这证实了拟议框架可以扩展到标准监督分类器之外.

blocks.en: For the DINO family, the observed trend is consistent with that reported for supervised ImageNet-pretrained models in Sec. 4.3 . In particular, PSP achieves the strongest compatibility results, with AC = 1.0 and ACA = 72.00, while LSP achieves AC = 0.67 and ACA = 47.02. As shown in Fig. 13 , the baseline achieves reasonable same-model retrieval performance, but cross-model retrieval remains negligible, indicating that independently pretrained self-supervised encoders do not naturally produce aligned representation spaces across updates.
blocks.zh: 对DINO家族来说,所观察到的趋势与Sec监督的ImageNet预训模型报告的趋势一致。 4.3 (英语). 尤其是PSP实现最强的兼容性结果,AC=1.0,ACA=72.00,而LSP实现AC=0.67,ACA=47.02. 如图13所示,基准实现合理的同型检索性能,但跨型检索仍然可以忽略不计,表明独立预先训练的自我监督编码器不会自然地在整个更新中产生一致的表示空间.

blocks.en: For the CLIP family, we observe the same overall pattern, as shown in Fig. 14 . PSP again achieves the strongest compatibility results (AC = 1.0, ACA = 59.20), while LSP improves substantially over the baseline but remains below PSP. The consistency of this behavior across both model families provides additional empirical support for the theoretical analysis in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 对于CLIP家族来说,我们观察到相同的整体模式,如图所示. 14,PSP再次取得最强的兼容性结果(AC=1.0,ACA=59.20),而LSP比基线大为改善,但仍低于PSP. 这两种模式家族的这种行为的一致性为第3.4 Sec. 中的理论分析提供了额外的经验支持.

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that a simple linear-probe protocol provides a practical way to apply PSP and LSP to pretrained encoders that do not natively expose a classification head, including both self-supervised and vision-language models.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果显示,简单的线性检测协议提供了一个实用的方法,可以应用PSP和LSP来预训编码器,这些编码器不会在本土上暴露一个分类头,包括自我监督的模型和视觉语言模型.
